frozenProtocol.fence: Snapshot after manual disappearance callback, parent reset and declared newer entry start/completion. Token/busy changes performed by candidate invalidation before this fence are permitted. Only later continuation writes are forbidden.
frozenProtocol.ordering: Explicit checked-continuation witnesses/releases; no ordering sleeps.

limits: A retained class/shared-parent surrogate does not prove actual SwiftUI State capture, location, retention or lifetime, NavigationStack disappearance, or fullScreenCover presentation/dismissal/capture ordering.
The parent disappearance callback may also occur around full-screen camera presentation; existing analysis cancellation already uses it. Camera authorization and capture behavior were not covered.
Newer-entry snapshots include shared parent fields. Their baseline changes do not prove that old A changed newer B-local token/busy state.
Token invalidation does not cancel the async task, interrupt an already-started transfer/preparation, prove OS inference compute release or establish memory improvement.
No PhotosUI/UIKit, real image decoding, camera, model, Simulator/app UI, physical-device, network-isolated offline, performance or accessibility result follows.
Prior eight-case36-check loading evidence remains separate and does not gain actual lifecycle coverage.
No package, archive, delivery, upload, distribution or submission-readiness claim follows from this record. Raw sources/logs/binaries remain local; no images or compiled artifacts are published here.
